title: UltraFeedback: Boosting Language Models with Scaled AI Feedback
authors_zh: Ganqu Cui、Lifan Yuan、Ning Ding、Guanming Yao、Bingxiang He、Wei Zhu、Yuan Ni、Guotong Xie、Ruobing Xie、Yankai Lin、Zhiyuan Liu、Maosong Sun（清华大学、伊利诺伊大学厄巴纳—香槟分校、ModelBest、平安科技、腾讯、中国人民大学、江苏语言能力协同创新中心）
paper_type_zh: 大规模 AI 反馈数据构造与对齐训练研究
best_for_zh: 适合需要构造反馈数据、训练奖励模型或搭建偏好对齐流程的研究者与工程人员。
one_line: UltraFeedback combines diverse instructions, multi-model answers, and GPT-4 critiques and scores into a large-scale alignment resource.
UltraFeedback 将多源指令、17 个模型回答与按四个维度给出的 GPT-4 反馈组织为大规模对齐资源。
why: It makes feedback construction itself a reusable training interface instead of reducing every judgment to a single final label.
inclusion_reason: Shows how structured AI feedback records can be constructed at scale and reused by reward-model and policy-training stages.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Human feedback can make language models more useful, but collecting it at the scale and diversity needed for broad alignment is expensive. Small preference sets also make it difficult to examine whether a reward model or policy is learning a general judgment rather than the habits of a narrow prompt collection.

This work asks how AI feedback can turn heterogeneous instructions and candidate answers into a reusable training resource. Its target is not merely more responses: it is a record in which the judged answer, the reasons for that judgment, and several quality dimensions can all be consumed by later alignment stages.

人工反馈能够提升语言模型的实用性，但要以足够的规模和多样性收集它来支持广泛对齐，成本十分高昂。规模较小的偏好集合还会使人难以判断：奖励模型或策略学到的究竟是通用的判断能力，还是某一狭窄提示集合中的习惯。

本文要解决的是，如何借助 AI 反馈，把异质的指令与候选回答转化为可复用的训练资源。它追求的不只是更多回答，而是一种能够让后续对齐阶段同时使用被评判的回答、判定理由和多个质量维度的记录。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
UltraFeedback treats scalable feedback construction as a structured annotation pipeline. It gathers instructions from several public sources, obtains answers from a pool of language models, and asks GPT-4 to critique and score those answers for instruction following, truthfulness, honesty, and helpfulness.

The resulting resource preserves more than a final preference label. By retaining written critiques and dimension-specific evaluations, the same collection can support reward modeling, response ranking, critique modeling, and policy optimization instead of tying the data to a single training objective.

UltraFeedback 将可扩展反馈构造视为一条结构化标注流水线。它从多个公开来源汇集指令，由一组语言模型生成回答，再请 GPT-4 围绕指令遵循、真实性、诚实性和有用性四个方面，对这些回答进行评析和评分。

得到的资源保留的不只是最终偏好标签。由于同时保存了文字评语和按维度给出的评价，同一批数据能够服务于奖励建模、回答排序、评析模型训练和策略优化，而不会被绑定到某一种训练目标上。

title: Method
方法
html:
The instruction pool combines sources including TruthfulQA, FalseQA, Evol-Instruct, UltraChat, ShareGPT, and a stratified sample from FLAN. The authors collect responses from 17 models, then prompt GPT-4 with evaluation criteria and reference answers so that it writes a critique before assigning scores and ranks.

They use the annotated collection to train a Llama 2 13B reward model, UltraRM, and also train a critique model. The paper then uses the learned reward model in best-of-n selection and PPO experiments, connecting the constructed feedback records to concrete policy-training consumers.

指令池结合了 TruthfulQA、FalseQA、Evol-Instruct、UltraChat、ShareGPT 以及从 FLAN 中分层抽取的样本。作者收集了 17 个模型的回答，随后在提示中提供评价准则和参考答案，让 GPT-4 先写出评析，再给出分数与排序。

作者利用已标注的集合训练了 Llama 2 13B 奖励模型 UltraRM，也训练了评析模型。论文接着在最佳候选选择和 PPO 实验中使用该奖励模型，从而把构造出的反馈记录连接到具体的策略训练使用方。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper reports more than one million GPT-4 feedback items for 250,000 user-assistant conversations. This scale is paired with a deliberately mixed instruction pool and multiple candidate models, so the evidence concerns both the amount of feedback and the breadth of the situations in which it was collected.

The released experiments evaluate the learned reward model and use it for best-of-n and PPO alignment. Those results support the practical claim that structured AI feedback can train useful downstream components, although they do not by themselves establish that GPT-4 judgments are an unbiased substitute for human judgment.

论文报告为 25 万组用户—助手对话收集了超过一百万条 GPT-4 反馈。这样的规模同时配合了刻意混合的指令池和多个候选模型，因此证据既涉及反馈数量，也涉及其所覆盖情境的广度。

公开实验评估了训练出的奖励模型，并将其用于最佳候选选择和 PPO 对齐。这些结果支持了结构化 AI 反馈能够训练有用下游组件这一实际主张，但本身并不能证明 GPT-4 的判断可以无偏地替代人类判断。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Earlier alignment datasets commonly supplied a small number of human comparisons or a single scalar preference. UltraFeedback changes the unit of collection by combining broad instructions, many model-generated alternatives, critiques, and multi-aspect scores in one feedback record.

Its contribution is therefore chiefly a data and supervision interface rather than a new optimizer. That interface makes the same AI judgment usable by several training stages and exposes information that would disappear if the collection were reduced immediately to a winning response.

较早的对齐数据集通常只提供少量人工比较，或只给出单一的标量偏好。UltraFeedback 改变了采集单位：它把广泛的指令、多个模型生成的候选回答、文字评析和多维评分放入同一条反馈记录中。

因此，它的主要贡献是一种数据与监督接口，而不是新的优化器。这一接口让同一份 AI 判断可供多个训练阶段使用，也保留了若在一开始便压缩成一个胜出回答时会丢失的信息。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The resource inherits the preferences, blind spots, and version-specific behavior of GPT-4, while the quality of labels also depends on the supplied criteria and reference answers. Recreating the pipeline may be costly or impossible when the proprietary judge changes, and mixing public instruction sources requires careful attention to their individual licenses and distribution constraints.
该资源会继承 GPT-4 的偏好、盲点以及与具体版本相关的行为，标签质量也取决于提供给评审器的准则和参考答案。当专有评审模型发生变化时，复现这条流水线可能成本高昂甚至无法实现；混合多个公开指令来源还需要仔细处理各自的许可证与分发限制。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this paper when designing a feedback dataset that must serve several consumers, such as a reward model, a response selector, or an aligned policy. It is especially useful for deciding which intermediate artifacts—candidate sets, rubrics, critiques, dimension scores, and ranks—should remain available instead of being collapsed into a binary preference pair.
当需要设计一套可服务于奖励模型、回答选择器或已对齐策略等多个使用方的反馈数据集时，可参考本文。它尤其适合帮助决定哪些中间产物应当保留，而非过早压缩为二元偏好对，例如候选集合、评分准则、文字评析、维度分数和排序。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: When reproducing or extending the work, inspect the provenance and mixture weights of the instruction sources, the exact candidate-model pool, the GPT-4 prompt and scoring schema, and how ties or inconsistent feedback are handled. Also separate evidence about reward-model quality from evidence about the final policy, because the two stages can fail for different reasons.
复现或扩展这项工作时，应检查指令来源的出处与混合权重、候选模型池的确切组成、GPT-4 的提示和评分格式，以及平局或前后不一致的反馈如何处理。还应把奖励模型质量的证据与最终策略质量的证据分开，因为两个阶段可能因不同原因失败。
